tools.description: Start a client-direct file upload for large CSV/XLSX files. Returns a presigned put_url and an opaque upload_id. tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Return the server's capability matrix (supported map types, geo types, output formats, and classification methods).

tools.name: process_upload
tools.description: Validate and ingest a file uploaded via create_upload.
